comprehensive_coverage.rationale: number_reading registers only 1 axis and 2 combos per variant_registry, a notably thin combo space for a competency spanning numbers all the way to 1000; validate_matrix checks that space exhaustively, but 2 combos is a narrow foundation for this range.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only 1 of the 5 samples reaches 3 digits (133); the other four are all 2-digit (38-98), so on this evidence the higher end of the stated 1000 range is underrepresented relative to the competency's full scope.

competency_alignment.rationale: The word-form conversion task stays correctly scoped to reading/writing numerals without drifting into place-value decomposition or arithmetic, matching this node's narrow wording.
